items.detail: Backup C Mitchell Robinson (about 18 mpg) is ruled out with illness for a third straight game, which ClutchPoints says could give Queta a larger center role.
Risacher started both weekend games while P.J. Washington (questionable, illness) sat; if Washington is out again, expect Risacher in the starting five with a bigger role.
